narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Opposite angles are equal, so angle W is sixty five degrees.
<bookmark mark='lean'/>That is true in a parallelogram. Here the slanting sides lean towards each other.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>They are not parallel, so opposite angles need not match.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>In an isosceles trapezium, the two angles on the same parallel side are equal.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Each of them and the angle above it add to one hundred eighty.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. An isosceles trapezium has angle U of seventy degrees. Find the other three angles.
